# Krishna Infosys

> ISO 9001:2015 ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems integrator in Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Since 2001 the company has designed, installed and maintained CCTV surveillance, fire alarm, access control, EPABX/intercom, public address, audio-visual, networking and building automation systems for businesses across India: 2,200+ projects for 950+ clients.

- Office: 15 & 16, 1st Floor, Swastik House, Stadium Cross Road, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad 380009, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 79 4030 4848 · Mobile/WhatsApp: +91 99794 85888
- Email: info@krishnainfosys.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 10:30–18:30, Sat 10:30–17:30 (IST)
- Service area: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Gujarat; multi-site projects pan-India
- Clients include Larsen & Toubro, Sterling Hospital, Ramdev Food Products, Nippon Express and DAV International School
- OEM brands supported: CP PLUS, Hikvision, Dahua, Prama, Honeywell, Bosch, Matrix, eSSL, HID, Panasonic, Pelco and others (multi-brand)

## Services

- [CCTV & access control](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/security-access): IP CCTV, access control, intrusion alarm, boom barriers, video door phones
- [Communication](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/communication): EPABX, intercom, video conferencing, public address
- [Audio visual](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/audio-visual): boardroom, auditorium and display systems
- [Networking & data](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/networking-data): structured cabling, LAN, Wi-Fi
- [Fire alarm & automation](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/automation-safety): fire detection and alarm, building and home automation
- [AMC & support](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/amc-support): annual maintenance contracts for CCTV, fire alarm and ELV systems, including systems installed by others
